cities.title: Cities / counties
cities.description: Which built-in Socrata permit datasets to pull. Each is processed one after another. Leave empty if you only want to use a custom portal below.

enumTitles: New York City, NY (DOB NOW: Build - Approved Permits)
New York City, NY (legacy DOB BIS Permit Issuance)
East Baton Rouge Parish, LA (Building Permits)

custom.title: Custom Socrata portal
custom.description: Optional. Pull any other Socrata dataset: {"domain": "data.example.gov", "datasetId": "abcd-1234", "fieldMap": {"permitNumber": "permit_no", "issuedDate": "issue_date", "permitType": "type", "estimatedCost": "valuation", "address": "site_address"}}. fieldMap keys are normalized output field names, values are the dataset's column names. Unmapped columns are passed through (except columns that look like personal owner/applicant data). issuedDate is needed for date filters and ordering.

issuedAfter.title: Issued on or after
issuedAfter.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only permits issued on or after this date.

issuedBefore.title: Issued before
issuedBefore.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only permits issued before this date (exclusive).

permitTypeContains.title: Permit type contains
permitTypeContains.description: Optional, case-insensitive substring match on the permit type field, e.g. "new construction", "demolition", "solar", "plumbing".

minEstimatedCost.title: Minimum estimated cost
minEstimatedCost.description: Optional. Skip permits whose declared valuation / estimated cost is below this amount (USD). Datasets without a cost field ignore this filter.

maxResultsPerCity.title: Maximum permits per city
maxResultsPerCity.description: Stop each city after this many permits. Each permit is one charged result.

includeRaw.title: Include raw record
includeRaw.description: Attach the untouched original portal record under `raw`. Note: raw records may contain fields the normalized output deliberately omits (see Data privacy in the README).

appToken.title: Socrata app token
appToken.description: Optional. A free Socrata application token, sent as X-App-Token for higher rate limits. Works without one.
